overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics resolution for zero-allocation stability, and compressing the storyteller narrative state into a fixed-size ring buffer. These steps ensure 100% coverage of the endgame phase with minimal memory footprint and maximal determinism.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hasher
acceptance_criteria: Hash value is identical across 1000 runs with same seed.
Compile time evaluation supported for static states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and enables fast-forward determinism checks.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Based Collision Resolution with Fixed Arrays
acceptance_criteria: Zero cache misses on sequential access.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smooth 60fps simulation even with high entity counts.

tasks.title: Compress Narrative State into Fixed Ring Buffer
tasks.player_fun_impact: Fast narrative context retrieval for AI decisions.
